_comment: Hood School. Earl, PhD in homies. The status-problem board uses the battle text's words (food poisoned, tased, passed out, burnt, iced out).
0: I'm Earl! Professor of the\nstreets, PhD in homies!\rI'ma make you a better Hustler!\rWhat you wanna know?\nYou tryna win? {YESNO 0}
1: Bet! Lesson one!\nThe homie at the top of your\fcrew, the one walkin' with you,\fjump out first in a scrap!\rSwitch up the order, make\nscraps easier, maybe!\rYou want more game from me? {YESNO 0}
2: So, you wanna know how to raise\nhomies right? {YESNO 0}
3:
Bet! Listen!
If a homie jump in a scrap even for a sec, it get some Exp. Points.Lead with the weak homie,
switch it out quick!That's how weak homies
come up strong! You want more game from me? {YESNO 0}
4: So, you wanna know how to\nscrap better? {YESNO 0}
5:
Bet! Listen up!
Homies got strengths and weaknesses 'cause of types.High-level homies don't always
win with bad matchups.Pick homies with types that
clap the other homie. That's a smart scrap!
6: Ohh! You a smart student!\nI got nothin' left to teach!\rBe good to your homies, aight?
7: I'm takin' notes on the teacher's\nlecture.\rI gotta copy the stuff off\nthe board too. Ugh.
8: I traded my best homie to the kid\nnext to me. Biggest L of my life.
9: Huh? The homie I just got is\nholdin' somethin'!
10: ...Some Berries can heal\na homie up.\rLots of other stuff homies\ncan hold too...\rTakin' notes is HARD, bro...
11:
Homies got somethin' called
abilities!Looks like every kind of homie
got its own thing.They say abilities come in
clutch in a scrap!
12: The board explain status\nproblems in scraps.\r
14: If it's food poisoned, a homie\nkeep losin' HP.\rIt don't stop after the scrap,\nyou lose HP walkin' too.\fHit it with a Pepto.\r
15: Gettin' tased cut speed and might\nstop it from movin'.\rIt stay after the scrap, so\nrub on some Icy Hot.\r
16: If your homie passed out, it can\nonly use moves like Dream Talk and\fLoud Snore.\rA passed-out homie don't wake up\nafter the scrap.\fWake it up with a Red Bull.\r
17: A burn eat HP, little by little,\nand cut the Attack stat too.\rIt stay after the scrap.\nSlap some Aloe Vera on it.\r
18: If your homie iced out,\nit can't do NOTHIN'.\rIt stay iced after the scrap.\nWarm it up with Hot Cheetos.\r

20: “Before you throw a Hood Ball,\nrough 'em up first.”\r“A food poisoned or burnt homie\nis easier to recruit.”\rKeep readin'? {YESNO 0}
